thread:
maria_support: Heads-up — Lumina GmbH invoice INV-2024-042 is blocked in billing because our tax validator returned 'inactive' from VIES. Customer insists VAT ID DE123456789 is active. Case CS-4921. Screenshot attached. Can billing/ops recheck or release?

jake_billing: Which internal invoice id? Also need the tax-lookup request_id so I can trace the call. If it's a VIES flake we can manual-release but need an audit note.

maria_support: Internal id 98765. Validator request_id r-0a9f3b. Customer uploaded their EU portal confirmation PDF and a registration cert (DE).

olga_ops: FYI there was a VIES partial outage yesterday ~07:10-07:35 UTC. Our validator cached negative results for 24h, so some IDs got marked inactive and held. Ops can flush the specific cache key.

sam_eng: Repro steps for eng/ops to rerun and clear cache:
```
# rerun external check
curl -s -X POST https://tax-validate.internal/revalidate \
  -H 'X-Request-Id: r-0a9f3b' \
  -d '{"vat_id":"DE123456789","country":"DE"}'
# expected success response
{"status":"active","details":"VIES 2024-04-08 07:40:12"}
```
Cache lives in Redis under key `tax:vat:DE:DE123456789` (TTL 86400s). To clear: `redis-cli DEL tax:vat:DE:DE123456789` or Admin UI: System > Tax validation > search VAT -> Clear cache.

jake_billing: If ops confirms cache cleared and revalidation returns active, I can release the invoice. Manual-release API (admin-only):
```
POST /api/admin/invoices/98765/release
Body: {"reason":"manual release after VIES recheck","note":"CS-4921, r-0a9f3b"}
```
Attach the customer certificate to the invoice record for audit.

olga_ops: Cleared Redis key and forced revalidation. New check returned 'active' from VIES (2024-04-08 07:42:01). Logs: tax-validate r-0a9f3b -> status active. Note added to system.

jake_billing: Released INV-2024-042 and added audit note. Customer will get the invoice now. :white_check_mark: @linus_cust please confirm receipt.

linus_cust: Got it — invoice received, thanks for the quick handling. Could you confirm why it failed initially? We renewed on the EU portal last week.

sam_eng: Short root cause: VIES intermittent failures during the 07:10-07:35 UTC window produced false 'inactive' responses; our validator cached negatives for 24h which caused a block. Plan: reduce TTL for negative results to 1h and add a retry/backoff specifically for negative responses occurring during known VIES instability. Opening ENG-1123 for the follow-up.

maria_support: Thanks everyone — I'll reply to the customer summarizing cause and attach their portal confirmation to the invoice. Closing CS-4921 after customer ack.
